cohort: The study analyzed hospital records of 100 cases of Maternal Near Miss (MNM) and Maternal Mortality (MM) at Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH), Bihar.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of Maternal Near Miss (MNM) cases compared to Maternal Mortality (MM), indicating the effectiveness of emergency obstetric interventions, while also identifying gaps in emergency obstetric care.
